prompt.zh: 答应一件事后，我有时才发现时间或资源不够。

scoring_model.formula: raw_sum = Σ(valid integer responses); mean_1_to_5 = raw_sum / valid_answer_count

factors.source_display_name: 直接表达可能造成的冲击
factors.result_headline: 回看直接表达与情境信息的关系
factors.one_sentence_summary: 这四道题观察先说结论、背景说明、语气时机和反馈接收条件的自评。
factors.score_reading: 平均值表示你对这四道陈述的整体符合程度，不分高低好坏。
factors.construct_definition: 观察直接表达在语气、时机和背景信息上的自评线索。
factors.item_scope: 题目覆盖：先说结论较少交代背景、时间紧时语气更简短、指出问题时未先确认接收时机、更关注内容准确较少留意表达冲击。
factors.behavior_outcome_boundary: 这些题目只描述你的自我报告行为，不包含他人感受或评价；结果不能确认别人是否被冲击或因此不喜欢你。
factors.review_angles: 可以回看：你通常在什么情况下先说结论；对方是否收到足够的背景信息。
factors.facts_to_check: 最近一次你说结论后对方追问背景的情境；那次是否涉及安全或不适合沟通的场合。
factors.safety_exception: 明确拒绝和安全边界无需包装成讨喜表达；在不安全情境中，直接停止沟通可能是必要保护。
factors.context_questions: 你直接表达是因为习惯，还是因为当时需要快速收尾？这个原因只能由你自己确认。
factors.low_risk_actions: 如果愿意，下次指出问题时可以先确认对方现在是否适合接收；也可以不做，不需要为每句话附上完整解释。
factors.no_people_pleasing_boundary: 直接不等于有问题，委婉也不天然更好；不需要为了被喜欢而软化所有表达。
factors.what_this_score_cannot_support: 它不能说明你粗鲁、缺乏共情、沟通能力差、别人被你伤害或别人因此讨厌你。
does_not_mean: 直接表达不等于粗鲁
委婉也不天然更好
不能确认他人是否被冲击
factors.science_boundary: 这是用于自我观察的产品化因素，未经独立心理测量验证。

factors.source_display_name: 暂时退开可能形成的距离感
factors.result_headline: 回看暂停联系时的说明方式
factors.one_sentence_summary: 这四道题观察需要空间时怎样暂停、是否说明状态和联系节奏变化的自评。
factors.score_reading: 平均值表示你对这四道陈述的整体符合程度，不分高低好坏。
factors.construct_definition: 观察需要空间时暂停联系与说明方式的自评线索。
factors.item_scope: 题目覆盖：需要空间时先减少联系后说明、疲惫时离开未约定回来、消息停留较久不说明、分歧后恢复联系未解释暂停。
factors.behavior_outcome_boundary: 这些题目只描述你的自我报告行为，不包含他人感受或评价；结果不能确认你冷漠或形成距离感。
factors.review_angles: 可以回看：你需要空间时通常怎样暂停；是否有安全或保护自己的考虑。
factors.facts_to_check: 最近一次你暂停联系的情境；那次是否出于自我保护或安全需要。
factors.safety_exception: 你可以停止与不安全对象的联系，无需承诺回来；暂停联系无需承诺恢复，自我保护不是需要修复的缺点。
factors.context_questions: 你没有说明暂停，是因为不习惯，还是因为说明本身不安全？这个区别只能由你自己确认。
factors.low_risk_actions: 如果愿意且安全允许，想暂停时可以说一句当前状态；也可以不做，安全不允许时直接暂停同样成立。
factors.no_people_pleasing_boundary: 你不需要为了避免被讨厌而保持联系；暂时退开不等于冷漠或惩罚。
factors.what_this_score_cannot_support: 它不能说明你冷漠、回避型人格、故意消失、惩罚对方、不在意关系或一定造成距离感。
does_not_mean: 暂停联系不等于冷漠
自我保护不是需要修复的缺点
无需承诺何时恢复联系
factors.science_boundary: 这是用于自我观察的产品化因素，未经独立心理测量验证。

factors.source_display_name: 期待没有说清造成的落差
factors.result_headline: 回看期待是怎样表达与确认的
factors.one_sentence_summary: 这四道题观察联系、分工和支持期待是否被明确讨论的自评。
factors.score_reading: 平均值表示你对这四道陈述的整体符合程度，不分高低好坏。
factors.construct_definition: 观察期待是否被直接说明、双方是否共同确认的自评线索。
factors.item_scope: 题目覆盖：假设对方知道标准、失望时未确认理解一致、合作前未逐项确认分工、用暗示代替直接说明。
factors.behavior_outcome_boundary: 这些题目只描述你的自我报告行为，不包含他人感受或评价；结果不能确认落差一定存在或由你造成。
factors.review_angles: 可以回看：你更常直接说明期待，还是更常假设对方知道；分工是否双方都清楚。
factors.facts_to_check: 最近一次期待落差出现的情境；那次是否双方都参与了说明。
factors.safety_exception: 如果期待差异伴随着威胁或控制，那已经不是沟通协调问题，安全优先。
factors.context_questions: 你没有直接说明期待，是因为不习惯，还是怕被拒绝？这个原因只能由你自己分辨。
factors.low_risk_actions: 如果愿意，下次开始前可以把期待写成可核对的具体事项；也可以不做，不需要为所有期待负责。
factors.no_people_pleasing_boundary: 期待和共识涉及多方，不能把责任单独归给你；表达期待不需要讨好。
factors.what_this_score_cannot_support: 它不能说明你自私、要求太多、不会沟通、双方不适合或你造成落差。
does_not_mean: 期待没说明不等于自私
落差涉及多方，不单独归因于你
不能确认他人一定感到落差
factors.science_boundary: 这是用于自我观察的产品化因素，未经独立心理测量验证。

factors.source_display_name: 回应或计划变化造成的不确定
factors.result_headline: 回看计划变化时的信息更新方式
factors.one_sentence_summary: 这四道题观察时间、资源、进度和变化通知的自评。
factors.score_reading: 平均值表示你对这四道陈述的整体符合程度，不分高低好坏。
factors.construct_definition: 观察计划变化、资源不足和进度更新方式的自评线索。
factors.item_scope: 题目覆盖：计划变化时较晚通知、答应后发现时间资源不够、任务未推进时未更新进度、回复节奏变化时未说明新安排。
factors.behavior_outcome_boundary: 这些题目只描述你的自我报告行为，不包含他人感受或评价；结果不能确认别人一定失望或讨厌你。
factors.review_angles: 可以回看：计划变化时你通常何时通知；资源不足时怎样处理。
factors.facts_to_check: 最近一次计划变化的情境；那次通知时间是否受现实条件影响。
factors.safety_exception: 如果通知或更新可能带来安全风险，优先保护自己；不需要向不安全的人更新安排。
factors.context_questions: 你没有及时更新，是因为忘记，还是因为担心对方反应？这个原因只能由你自己判断。
factors.low_risk_actions: 如果愿意，下次计划变化时可以尽早说明；也可以不做，不需要承诺超出能力的范围。
factors.no_people_pleasing_boundary: 行动建议不能要求过度承诺，也不能承诺获得信任；计划变化是常见情况。
factors.what_this_score_cannot_support: 它不能说明你不可靠、缺乏责任感、不值得信任、职业表现差或别人一定失望讨厌你。
does_not_mean: 计划变化不等于不可靠
不承诺超出能力范围
不能确认他人一定失望
factors.science_boundary: 这是用于自我观察的产品化因素，未经独立心理测量验证。

factors.source_display_name: 边界表达方式产生的误读
factors.result_headline: 回看边界表达方式与理解差异
factors.one_sentence_summary: 这四道题观察拒绝、靠近、距离和边界表达方式的自评。
factors.score_reading: 平均值表示你对这四道陈述的整体符合程度，不分高低好坏。
factors.construct_definition: 观察边界表达方式与对方理解差异的自评线索。
factors.item_scope: 题目覆盖：拒绝时说得简短未说明范围、希望停下时用暗示、边界差异未及时说明、靠近或距离的表达与对方习惯不同。
factors.behavior_outcome_boundary: 这些题目只描述你的自我报告行为，不包含他人感受或评价；结果不能确认误读一定发生或由你负责。
factors.review_angles: 可以回看：你更常直接说清边界，还是更常用暗示；不同关系中的边界是否被说明。
factors.facts_to_check: 最近一次边界表达后的情境；那次对方是否尊重你的选择。
factors.safety_exception: 清楚地说“不”本身就可以构成完整边界，无需提供替代方案；向不安全的人解释边界不是义务。
factors.context_questions: 你更常用暗示而非直接说明，是习惯还是担心直接表达有风险？这个区别只能由你自己判断。
factors.low_risk_actions: 如果愿意且安全允许，想表达边界时可以直接说明；也可以不做，表达方式不同不等于需要降低边界。
factors.no_people_pleasing_boundary: 不同表达方式不能变成要求你为他人理解承担全部责任；不需要为了被喜欢而降低边界。
factors.what_this_score_cannot_support: 它不能说明你边界有问题、必须解释拒绝、必须提供可接受替代方案、应该降低边界或他人误读一定是你的责任。
does_not_mean: 拒绝简短不表示边界有问题
清楚地说“不”本身就可以构成完整边界
无需提供替代方案
factors.science_boundary: 这是用于自我观察的产品化因素，未经独立心理测量验证。

states.title: 这次没有足够的作答
states.summary: 未完整作答时不提供任何因素解释。
states.what_happened: 本次提交缺少部分题目的答案，因此不计算因素分数。
states.what_user_can_do: 可以继续作答补全，也可以直接退出。退出前，当前设备上已有的逐题选择仍会保存在本地草稿中并支持恢复；未完整提交不会生成最终结果缓存。
states.interpretation_suppression: 不猜测未回答的题目，不推测未答选项，也不根据已有答案先给判断。
states.no_dislike_inference: 没有结果不产生任何他人评价或讨厌原因结论；未完成作答不暗示你逃避缺点或不敢面对自己。
states.safety_boundary: 如果你因为安全原因选择不继续，这完全成立；不继续作答不需要向任何人解释。
states.science_boundary: 没有结果不构成任何人际或社交结论。

states.title: 结果暂不可用
states.summary: 题库、评分或内容版本不匹配时停止解释。
states.what_happened: 本题库、评分或内容版本之间存在不匹配，无法按当前规则生成结果。
states.what_user_can_do: 这是版本层面的问题，不是你的作答问题。无需重做或反复尝试，可以在版本更新后重新查看。
states.interpretation_suppression: 不显示旧版本结果，不做部分解释，不把工程错误解释成用户问题。
states.no_dislike_inference: 该状态不涉及任何他人评价或社交判断。
states.safety_boundary: 该状态不影响现实安全判断；如有安全顾虑，仍按现实情况处理。
states.science_boundary: 该状态不构成任何人际结论。

states.title: 有几个因素分数相同
states.summary: 因素均值相同只表示本次回答中的数值相同，不表示多个缺点同样严重，也不产生负面人格类型。
states.what_happened: 本次计算后，两个或更多因素的原始总和相同。
states.what_user_can_do: 可以按原样分别阅读每个因素，不需要为它们排出先后。
states.interpretation_suppression: 不打破并列，不指定主要原因，不生成负面人格，不表示多个缺点同样严重，不表示你的问题很多，也不表示测试失效；因素题目不同，数值相同不表示影响相同。
states.no_dislike_inference: 并列不产生任何讨厌原因或他人评价结论。
states.safety_boundary: 并列不代表你需要改变任何边界；安全边界不受分数影响。
states.science_boundary: 相同数值不构成任何人际结论。

common.first_screen_boundary: 请先了解六件事：互动摩擦线索测试只记录自我报告，本测试没有询问任何其他人；结果只反映你本次对五组自我描述的符合程度；结果不能证明谁讨厌你，也不能确定任何人的真实评价；结果不判断人格缺陷、社交价值或主要问题；你不需要为了获得喜欢而迎合、过度解释或降低边界；在不安全关系中，安全优先，可以停止联系。
common.product_name_boundary: 互动摩擦线索测试记录本次对五组互动情境陈述的整体符合程度。正式结果使用本次互动摩擦线索、自我报告的互动回顾、值得结合事实继续核对的沟通情境等表述。
common.measurement_theme: 本次结果记录五组互动情境陈述的自评符合程度：直接表达与情境信息、暂停联系与说明方式、期待表达与共同确认、计划变化与信息更新、边界表达与理解差异。
common.how_to_read_raw_sum: 原始总和是四道题回答数值之和，范围 4–20；它只在本次回答内有意义，不代表任何等级。
common.how_to_read_mean: 平均值是把总和除以四，范围 1–5。平均值越接近 5，只表示总体上更同意这四个陈述；越接近 1，只表示总体上较少同意。
common.independent_factor_boundary: 五个因素各自独立阅读，不合并、不加减、不比较谁更严重。
common.no_total_score: 本测试不计算总分，也不计算讨厌指数或社交缺陷分。
common.no_ranking: 五个因素不能互相排名，不识别主要负面原因，不产生最严重缺点。
common.no_threshold: 本测试没有高、中、低标签，不划分严重或轻微，不设置人际风险等级。
common.aggregate_not_item_level_boundary: 分数只表示你对每组四道陈述的整体符合程度，不能确认你在任一道具体题目中的回答；具体情况仍需结合事实、安全和关系情境核对。
common.self_report_only_boundary: 本测试只有用户自评，没有他人反馈、同伴报告、伴侣报告、行为观察、真实冲突记录或社交排斥数据。
common.no_observer_data: 结果最多只能说明用户本次对若干互动情境陈述的整体符合程度；不能说明这些行为真实发生过或他人观察到了这些行为。
common.no_real_dislike_reason: 本测试没有询问任何其他人，不能确定谁讨厌用户，也不能确定任何人讨厌用户的真实原因。
common.no_character_defect: 结果不判断人格缺陷、社交价值或主要问题，不产生被讨厌人格或负面人格类型。
common.no_social_value: 不计算人缘分数、受欢迎程度或社交价值。
common.no_third_party_mind_reading: 结果不能读取他人心理，不能确定别人觉得你冷漠、不可靠或有距离感。
common.no_people_pleasing: 不建议为了获得喜欢而迎合、过度解释、过度承诺或降低边界。
common.boundary_does_not_require_approval: 清楚地说“不”本身就可以构成完整边界，无需提供理由、替代方案或获得他人批准；你不需要为了避免被讨厌而降低边界。
common.safety_exception: 用户没有义务为了避免被讨厌而保持联系；没有义务向不安全的人解释边界；暂停联系无需承诺恢复；清楚地说“不”本身就可以构成完整边界，拒绝无需提供替代方案。在暴力、胁迫、控制、跟踪、骚扰或安全威胁情境中，安全优先：可以暂停联系，向可信的人、当地紧急服务或合适的专业支持求助。不将减少联系、阻止联系或不回复自动解释为沟通问题；不要求与施害者共同协商；不为伤害行为寻找双向原因；不把自我保护写成回避、冷漠或需要修复的缺点。
common.no_diagnosis: 本测试不是医疗、心理或关系诊断，也没有完成心理测量学验证。
common.no_high_stakes_use: 所有页面行动建议都可选择不做。不要把结果用于医疗、司法、招聘、学校或升学、安保、伴侣或关系筛选、关系去留等高风险事项；行动建议也不用于酒精、药物、赌博、自伤、进食障碍、危险行为或戒断管理。
common.privacy_boundary: 答题过程中，包含逐题选择的本地草稿会保存在当前设备并支持恢复。完成后的最终结果缓存保存各因素原始总和与平均值等结果；最终结果缓存不包含原始逐题答案。本地测评流程不会上传这些内容；可以在结果页清除本次草稿和最终结果缓存。不需要向任何人公开结果。
common.public_preview_notice: 本测试仅供娱乐与自我探索；尚未完成信度、效度、常模、公平性、百分位或准确率验证。
common.psychometric_boundary: 全部为负向自陈题，分数容易受自我呈现和理解差异影响；本测试未完成心理测量验证，不能当作诊断、评估或社交建议依据。
common.retest_boundary: 如果以后重新作答，应按当时能确认的状态选择；两次结果不同可能与对象、情境或自我理解变化有关，不能自动解释为你的互动方式已经改变。

english_factor_translation.source_display_name: Impact that direct expression might have
english_factor_translation.result_headline: Review the relationship between direct expression and context
english_factor_translation.one_sentence_summary: These four items concern your reports of conclusions first, background, tone and timing, and conditions for receiving feedback.
english_factor_translation.score_reading: The mean describes overall endorsement of these four statements, without a good/bad or high/low category.
english_factor_translation.construct_definition: Self-reported clues about the tone, timing and background surrounding direct expression.
english_factor_translation.item_scope: The items cover conclusions with less background, a more clipped tone under time pressure, pointing out a problem without checking timing, and focusing on accuracy with less attention to delivery.
english_factor_translation.behavior_outcome_boundary: The items describe only your self-report, without other people’s feelings or evaluations. They cannot confirm that someone was affected or disliked you because of it.
english_factor_translation.review_angles: You may review when you tend to begin with a conclusion and whether the other person received enough background.
english_factor_translation.facts_to_check: Recall a recent occasion when someone asked for background after your conclusion, including whether the setting was unsafe or unsuitable for discussion.
english_factor_translation.safety_exception: A clear refusal or safety boundary need not be packaged to be likeable. Directly ending an unsafe conversation can be necessary protection.
english_factor_translation.context_questions: Was your direct expression habitual, or did you need to finish quickly? Only you can check that reason.
english_factor_translation.low_risk_actions: If you wish, next time you point out a problem you could first check whether this is a suitable time. You may also choose not to; every sentence does not need a full explanation.
english_factor_translation.no_people_pleasing_boundary: Directness is not inherently a problem and tact is not inherently better. You do not need to soften every expression to be liked.
english_factor_translation.what_this_score_cannot_support: This cannot show that you are rude, lack empathy, communicate poorly, hurt someone or are disliked because of it.
does_not_mean: Direct expression does not mean rudeness.
Tact is not inherently better.
The form cannot confirm that another person was affected.
english_factor_translation.science_boundary: This is a product-organised area for self-observation, without independent psychometric validation.

english_factor_translation.source_display_name: Distance that stepping away might create
english_factor_translation.editorial_display_name: Pausing contact and explaining your situation
english_factor_translation.result_headline: Review how you describe a pause in contact
english_factor_translation.one_sentence_summary: These four items concern reports of pausing when you need space, explaining your situation and changes in contact rhythm.
english_factor_translation.score_reading: The mean describes overall endorsement of these four statements, without a good/bad or high/low category.
english_factor_translation.construct_definition: Self-reported clues about pausing contact and explaining your situation when you need space.
english_factor_translation.item_scope: The items cover reducing contact before explaining, leaving when tired without a return arrangement, leaving messages without explanation, and resuming contact without explaining a pause.
english_factor_translation.behavior_outcome_boundary: The items describe only your self-report, without other people’s feelings or evaluations. They cannot confirm that you are cold or that distance was created.
english_factor_translation.review_angles: You may review how you usually pause when you need space and whether protection or safety mattered.
english_factor_translation.facts_to_check: Recall a recent pause in contact and whether it was for protection or safety.
english_factor_translation.safety_exception: You may stop contact with an unsafe person without promising to return. A pause need not include a promise to resume, and protection is not a defect that needs repair.
english_factor_translation.context_questions: Was the lack of explanation habitual, or was explaining itself unsafe? Only you can check that distinction.
english_factor_translation.low_risk_actions: If you wish and it is safe, you could briefly state your situation when pausing. You may also choose not to; directly pausing is valid when safety does not allow an explanation.
english_factor_translation.no_people_pleasing_boundary: You do not need to maintain contact to avoid being disliked. Stepping away does not establish coldness or punishment.
english_factor_translation.what_this_score_cannot_support: This cannot show coldness, an avoidant personality, deliberate disappearance, punishment, lack of care or an inevitable creation of distance.
does_not_mean: Pausing contact does not mean coldness.
Self-protection is not a defect to repair.
You need not promise when contact will resume.
english_factor_translation.science_boundary: This is a product-organised area for self-observation, without independent psychometric validation.

english_factor_translation.editorial_display_name: Expressing expectations and checking shared understanding
english_factor_translation.result_headline: Review how expectations were expressed and checked
english_factor_translation.one_sentence_summary: These four items concern reports of explicitly discussing expectations of contact, task allocation and support.
english_factor_translation.score_reading: The mean describes overall endorsement of these four statements, without a good/bad or high/low category.
english_factor_translation.construct_definition: Self-reported clues about directly stating expectations and jointly checking understanding.
english_factor_translation.item_scope: The items cover assuming standards are known, feeling disappointed before checking shared understanding, not confirming responsibilities before a joint task, and hinting rather than explaining.
english_factor_translation.behavior_outcome_boundary: The items describe only your self-report, without other people’s feelings or evaluations. They cannot confirm that a gap exists or that you caused it.
english_factor_translation.review_angles: You may review whether you state expectations directly or assume they are known, and whether responsibilities were clear to both people.
english_factor_translation.facts_to_check: Recall a recent expectation gap, including whether both people took part in explaining.
english_factor_translation.safety_exception: If differing expectations involve threats or control, safety takes priority over communication coordination.
english_factor_translation.context_questions: Was not stating an expectation habitual, or were you afraid of refusal? Only you can distinguish that reason.
english_factor_translation.low_risk_actions: If you wish, next time you could write expectations as specific points that can be checked before starting. You may also choose not to and are not responsible for every expectation.
english_factor_translation.no_people_pleasing_boundary: Expectations and agreement involve more than one person. Responsibility cannot be assigned solely to you, and expressing an expectation need not involve pleasing others.
english_factor_translation.what_this_score_cannot_support: This cannot show selfishness, excessive demands, poor communication, incompatibility or that you caused a gap.
does_not_mean: Unspoken expectations do not mean selfishness.
A gap involves more than one person, not solely you.
The form cannot confirm that another person felt a gap.
english_factor_translation.science_boundary: This is a product-organised area for self-observation, without independent psychometric validation.

english_factor_translation.source_display_name: Uncertainty from responses or changing plans
english_factor_translation.result_headline: Review information updates when plans change
english_factor_translation.one_sentence_summary: These four items concern reports of time, resources, progress and notifications of change.
english_factor_translation.score_reading: The mean describes overall endorsement of these four statements, without a good/bad or high/low category.
english_factor_translation.construct_definition: Self-reported clues about changing plans, resource limits and progress updates.
english_factor_translation.item_scope: The items cover late notice of changes, discovering resource or time limits after agreeing, not updating a stalled task and not explaining a changed response rhythm.
english_factor_translation.behavior_outcome_boundary: The items describe only your self-report, without other people’s feelings or evaluations. They cannot confirm that another person was disappointed or disliked you.
english_factor_translation.review_angles: You may review when you notify others of changes and how you handle resource limits.
english_factor_translation.facts_to_check: Recall a recent change of plans and whether practical conditions affected the timing of the notice.
english_factor_translation.safety_exception: If an update could create a safety risk, protect yourself first. You do not need to update an unsafe person on your arrangements.
english_factor_translation.context_questions: Did you not update promptly because you forgot or because you feared a response? Only you can judge the reason.
english_factor_translation.low_risk_actions: If you wish, next time plans change you could explain earlier. You may also choose not to, and need not promise more than you can manage.
english_factor_translation.no_people_pleasing_boundary: An action suggestion must not demand excessive commitments or promise that trust will follow. Plans commonly change.
english_factor_translation.what_this_score_cannot_support: This cannot show unreliability, irresponsibility, untrustworthiness, poor work performance or that others must be disappointed or dislike you.
does_not_mean: A changed plan does not mean unreliability.
Do not promise beyond what you can manage.
The form cannot confirm another person’s disappointment.
english_factor_translation.science_boundary: This is a product-organised area for self-observation, without independent psychometric validation.

english_factor_translation.editorial_display_name: Expressing boundaries and differences in understanding
english_factor_translation.result_headline: Review boundary expression and differences in understanding
english_factor_translation.one_sentence_summary: These four items concern reports of refusal, closeness, distance and ways of expressing boundaries.
english_factor_translation.score_reading: The mean describes overall endorsement of these four statements, without a good/bad or high/low category.
english_factor_translation.construct_definition: Self-reported clues about expressing boundaries and possible differences in understanding.
english_factor_translation.item_scope: The items cover brief refusals without describing a range, hints when wanting something to stop, not promptly explaining different boundaries, and unfamiliar expressions of closeness or distance.
english_factor_translation.behavior_outcome_boundary: The items describe only your self-report, without other people’s feelings or evaluations. They cannot confirm that misunderstanding occurred or that you were responsible.
english_factor_translation.review_angles: You may review whether you state boundaries directly or use hints, and whether differences between relationships were explained.
english_factor_translation.facts_to_check: Recall a recent occasion after expressing a boundary, including whether your choice was respected.
english_factor_translation.safety_exception: A clear no can be a complete boundary without an alternative. Explaining a boundary to an unsafe person is not an obligation.
english_factor_translation.context_questions: Were hints habitual, or did direct expression seem risky? Only you can judge that distinction.
english_factor_translation.low_risk_actions: If you wish and it is safe, you could state a boundary directly. You may also choose not to; different expression does not require a lower boundary.
english_factor_translation.no_people_pleasing_boundary: Different expression must not make you solely responsible for another person’s understanding. You need not lower boundaries to be liked.
english_factor_translation.what_this_score_cannot_support: This cannot show that your boundaries are wrong, that you must explain a refusal or provide an alternative, that you should lower a boundary, or that misunderstanding is necessarily your responsibility.
does_not_mean: A brief refusal does not mean a faulty boundary.
A clear no can itself be a complete boundary.
You need not offer an alternative.
english_factor_translation.science_boundary: This is a product-organised area for self-observation, without independent psychometric validation.
